tasks.label: adb reverse (docker 5121)
tasks.detail: Bridge a USB-connected phone's localhost:5121 to the laptop's API (docker compose).

tasks.label: adb reverse (dotnet run 5126)
tasks.detail: Bridge a USB-connected phone's localhost:5126 to the laptop's API (dotnet run).

tasks.label: run mobile over Wi-Fi (docker 5121)
tasks.detail: Connect the phone over Wi-Fi (adb tcpip), adb reverse, then flutter run against the docker-compose API (env.device.json).

tasks.label: run mobile over Wi-Fi (dotnet run 5126)
tasks.detail: Same as above but against a locally run API on 5126 (env.local.json). Cable needed only the first time / after a phone reboot.
